title: SEBI (Foreign Institutional Investors) (Amendment) Regulations, 2006
text: Home »Legal»Circulars SEBI (Foreign Institutional Investors) (Amendment) Regulations, 2006 Sep 12, 2006| Circulars Investment Management Department Division of Foreign Institutional Investors and Custodians Circular No. IMD/FII&C/22/2006 September 12, 2006 To Foreign Institutional Investors and Custodians of Securities Dear Sir / Madam, Sub: SEBI (Foreign Institutional Investors) (Amendment) Regulations, 2006 Enclosed please find a copy of the gazette notification no. S.O.1332 (E) dated August 21, 2006 pertaining to SEBI (Foreign Institutional Investors) (Amendment) Regulations, 2006 for your information and necessary action. A copy of the circular is available at the web page “Foreign Institutional Investors” on our website www.sebi.gov.in . Yours faithfully, Sangeeta Uchil Deputy General Manager Encl.: SEBI (Foreign Institutional Investors) (Amendment) Regulations, 2006
